summary: This note describes German submarine U-326, a Type VIIC/41 U-boat of Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine in World War II. The boat carried out one patrol during which it failed to sink or damage any ships. U-326 was sunk in May 1945 in the Bay of Biscay by an American aircraft.
one_line: U-326 was a Type VIIC/41 Kriegsmarine U-boat that made one fruitless patrol and was sunk by an American aircraft in May 1945.
key_facts: German submarine U-326 was a Type VIIC/41 U-boat of Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine during World War II.
U-326 carried out one patrol during its service.
U-326 failed to sink or damage any ships during its one patrol.
U-326 was sunk in the Bay of Biscay.
U-326 was sunk by an American aircraft.
